items.name: Aloe
items.role: The featured-tier and "growth" accent. Used as a pill button background on light surfaces and as a feature-card fill in the pricing comparison band.

items.name: Pistachio
items.role: Softer than aloe; used as a wide section band fill on the light track to signal a different category of feature without leaving the green family.

items.name: Cool Link Tones
items.role: Muted footer / tertiary link colors used on dark surfaces to create a quiet hierarchy below the primary white type.

items.name: Canvas Night
items.role: Pure black hero, cinematic feature pages, footer.

items.name: Canvas Night Elevated
items.role: Cards on cinematic surfaces, video frames.

items.name: Surface Elevated Dark
items.role: Dark teal-shifted surface used on a small subset of dark cards to introduce subtle depth without breaking the black.

items.name: Canvas Cream
items.role: Slightly warm off-white used on the pricing-page background canvas — invisibly different from #ffffff but adds editorial warmth.

items.name: Hairline Light
items.role: 1px borders on light cards, table dividers.

items.name: Hairline Dark
items.role: 1px borders on the rare dark cards that have visible chrome.

items.name: Shade-30
items.role: Tag / chip background on light, footer hairline on dark.

items.name: Shade-40
items.role: Tertiary text on light, secondary text on dark.

items.name: Shade-60
items.role: Tertiary text on light, deep on dark.

items.name: Shade-70
items.role: Pressed-state of the primary pill button; deep dark surface accent.

items.name: On Primary
items.role: All text on dark canvas + filled-pill labels.
